Markets Rally as Inflation Cools

By Sam Analyst

Global equity markets advanced on Tuesday after a cooler-than-expected inflation report eased pressure on central banks to keep rates elevated for longer.

Benchmark indexes in New York, London, and Tokyo posted gains, with technology and consumer shares leading the advance. Bond yields slipped as traders priced in a higher chance of policy easing next quarter.

Economists cautioned that one report does not define a trend, but said the data reduces the risk of an aggressive tightening surprise. Corporate earnings this week will be the next major catalyst for sentiment.
